validationRule.title: stop_times_updates not strictly sorted
validationRule.errorDescription: stop_time_updates for a given trip_id must be strictly sorted by increasing stop_sequence
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: is not strictly sorted by increasing stop_sequence

validationRule.title: GTFS-rt stop_sequence isn't provided for trip that visits same stop_id more than once
validationRule.errorDescription: If a GTFS trip contains multiple references to the same stop_id (i.e., the vehicle visits the same stop_id more than once in the same trip), then GTFS-rt stop_time_updates for this trip must include stop_sequence
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: more than once and GTFS-rt stop_time_update is missing stop_sequence field - stop_sequence must be provided

validationRule.title: Sequential stop_time_updates have the same stop_id
validationRule.errorDescription: Sequential GTFS-rt trip stop_time_updates shouldn't have the same stop_id
